bends.note: 5th changes direction at Pike: west of Pike it runs ESE (sheet 124 segment, centreline meets Pike at the Pike/5th T 430,958), east of Pike it runs ENE and its centreline meets Pike's centreline here, ~120 px further north (the two segments are offset, not a clean single crossing)

ends.note: dead end inside the block; 20' at Butler, printed 15' at this west end; lots close it off

notes: Sheet is drawn rotated about 28 deg against sheet 124: here Pike, Butler, Culvert and Eggleston run roughly N-S (Butler, Culvert and Eggleston lean SSE) and 3rd, 4th (east part) and Pearl run E-W, while 5th east of Pike runs ENE. Streets west of Pike belong to sheet 124 and enter at an angle: E 5th (ESE), Buchanan (17 ft gap in Pike's west face at y~1416-1478, centreline carried to Pike's centre gives the T point), and E 4th (52 ft, faces y~1733/1915, T at Pike; the east side of Pike is unbroken, Pugh Power Building). East of Pike, 4th only resumes at Butler (printed 30', T at Butler) and runs to Eggleston (T; tracks along Eggleston beyond). BUTLER (33' north of 3rd, 30' south of 3rd; west strip printed 'BUTLER (From Plans)' near 5th) runs 5th to Pearl and continues south (pipes), T at 5th because the street north of 5th lines up with Culvert, not Butler. CULVERT (printed 43' at 3rd, ~36 ft near 5th) runs north of 5th onto sheet 136 (name not printed there on this sheet; the opening north of 5th lines up with Culvert within ~20 px, so recorded as Culvert/5th cross) and ends at 3rd (T). EGGLESTON AV. is printed 91' with railroad tracks running along it; its east side has blocks only at 5th and 3rd; points are on the middle of the 91 ft width (Eggleston/5th is near the top edge inside a paste-over; Eggleston/Pearl estimated from the west face plus half the width, +-20 px). WADE COURT (20') runs west from Butler to a dead end. An unnamed 10' alley runs south from 3rd at x~2368 to the factory block at y~3420. Pearl's south face is at the bottom paper edge; Pearl points use the north face plus 60 ft and agree with the pipe pair. Elevation circles (107, 84, 78, 67, 101, 78, 62, 74, 68, 62) sit at the recorded junctions.
